init_drboost_task: initialize a DrBoostTask instance with a list of checkpoint paths for weak encoders
setup_weak_encoders: load multiple weak encoder checkpoints into a ModuleList during the setup phase
encode_queries_drboost: encode query token IDs by concatenating representations from all weak encoders
encode_contexts_drboost: encode context token IDs by concatenating representations from all weak encoders
export_torchscript_drboost: export DrBoostTask encoders to TorchScript format with optional quantization support
